lines: Dayar-e-dil ki raat mein charagh sa jala gaya
couplets.en: In the heart's night, he left a little lamp alight.

lines: Dayar-e-dil ki raat mein charagh sa jala gaya
couplets.en: In the heart's night, he left a little lamp alight.

lines: Mila nahin to kya hua, woh shakl to dikha gaya
couplets.en: So what if we never met, when I caught a glimpse of his face?

lines: Judaiyon ke zakhm dard-e-zindagi ne bhar diye
couplets.en: Life's own sorrow healed the wounds that parting left.

lines: Tujhe bhi neend aa gayi, mujhe bhi sabr aa gaya
couplets.en: Sleep came to you, and I grew used to waiting.

lines: Mila nahin to kya hua, woh shakl to dikha gaya
couplets.en: So what if we never met, when I caught a glimpse of his face?

lines: Yeh subah ki safediyan, yeh dopahar ki zardiyan
couplets.en: Here are the whites of morning and the pale yellows of noon.

lines: Ab aaine mein dekhta hoon, main kahan chala gaya
couplets.en: Now I look in the mirror and wonder where I went.

lines: Woh chhoti chhoti ranjishon ka lutf bhi chala gaya
couplets.en: Even the sweetness of our little quarrels is gone.

lines: Yeh kis khushi ki ret par ghamon ko neend aa gayi
couplets.en: On the sands of what joy did my sorrows fall asleep?

lines: Woh lehar kis taraf gayi, yeh main kahan sama gaya
couplets.en: Where did that wave go, and where did I disappear?
